name: FlexiQuiz
summary: Online quiz and test maker for educators, trainers and businesses: build graded exams, assessments and simple courses with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — from a genuinely free tier.
best_for: educators, trainers and small teams that want professional graded quizzes, exams and simple courses — with certificates, timed tests, question banks and analytics — without building out a full LMS
skip_if: you need a complete learning platform with deep integrations, or your volumes run past a few thousand responses a month — the caps make it the wrong shape
honest_knock: The monthly response caps are the business model: 20 on free, 500 on Essentials, 2,000 on Premium and 25,000 on Enterprise -- one viral quiz or one big exam cohort and you're shopping a tier up. The per-response price falls steeply as you climb ($0.034, $0.0125, $0.0024 on yearly billing), so the ceiling is the thing to price, not the sticker. Administrator seats are capped separately at 1, 2 and 15, and sharing a login is against the terms.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month billed monthly or $17/mo billed yearly ($204/yr)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on flexiquiz.com/Home/Plans, every amount unchanged; the monthly-billed rates were read from the page's own billing-toggle script, the yearly rates from the rendered cards) Free: 20 responses a month, no card required. Essentials $25/mo billed monthly or $17/mo billed yearly ($204/yr) -- 500 responses a month, 1 administrator, unlimited quizzes and questions, question bank, live quizzes, auto grading. Premium $39/mo monthly or $25/mo yearly ($300/yr) -- 2,000 responses a month, 2 administrators or trainers, learning paths, selling quizzes and courses, custom certificates, embedding, self-registration. Enterprise $89/mo monthly or $60/mo yearly ($720/yr) -- 25,000 responses a month, 15 administrators or trainers, APIs and webhooks, single sign-on, white-label emails, custom CSS, 100 custom groups, 24/7 priority support. Enterprise+ is tailored and quoted by sales. Yearly billing works out 32-36% cheaper than monthly, which is more than the 'save over 25%' the toggle advertises. Purchases over $300 can be invoiced for bank transfer or cheque against an additional $50 fee.

free_plan_evidence: (re-verified 2026-09-22 on flexiquiz.com/Home/Plans, every amount unchanged; the monthly-billed rates were read from the page's own billing-toggle script, the yearly rates from the rendered cards) Free: 20 responses a month, no card required.

compare_with.name: Typeform or Google Forms
compare_with.why: the generic form tools win on price and ubiquity for simple surveys; FlexiQuiz wins on exam features — grading, certificates, timed tests and question banks
